list.definition:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "snmp_ups_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "load_percent")
  |> group(columns: ["hostname"])
  |> distinct(column: "hostname")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
